{{Top}}
The '''Propaganda Bureau''' was an arm of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Ministry of Education (Alliance)|Ministry of Education]]. The Bureau was charged with presenting the Alliance's face to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], which they achieved by countering [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] propaganda which depicted the Alliance as little more than lawless outlaws and madmen. The [[Declaration of Rebellion/Legends|Declaration of Rebellion]] helped to dissuade that notion, forcing the Empire to shift their focus and expound upon the notion that the Empire's [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] was too formidable for the Alliance to overcome. The Propaganda Bureau countered this by distributing over 20,000 [[Hologram disc/Legends|holo-tapes]] of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destruction]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] over [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].
